grammar.title: A more formal "for example" with 例如
grammar.explanation: 例如 (lìrú) means "for example, such as" a more formal version of 比如, often used in writing or careful explanations.

sentences.zh: 他会很多运动，例如篮球。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huì hěn duō yùndòng, lìrú lánqiú.
sentences.en: He knows many sports, for example basketball.

sentences.zh: 这个国家有很多节日，例如新年。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège guójiā yǒu hěn duō jiérì, lìrú xīnnián.
sentences.en: This country has many festivals, for example New Year.

sentences.zh: 我们要重视这些问题，例如安全。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhòngshì zhèxiē wèntí, lìrú ānquán.
sentences.en: We need to take these issues seriously, for example safety.

sentences.zh: 很多人喜欢运动，例如打球。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén xǐhuan yùndòng, lìrú dǎqiú.
sentences.en: Many people like sports, for example playing ball games.
